mines.mine_notes: Underground mine, Durango state (Avino Property); 100% owned. FY2025: 736,935 dry tonnes milled (+14% vs 2024); produced 1,157,828 oz Ag, 7,621 oz Au, 5,667,996 lb Cu (2,606,155 AgEq oz). Cash cost $16.13/AgEq payable oz sold; AISC $23.75/AgEq payable oz sold. Head grades not disclosed in annual report (fields null). Costs are per silver-equivalent ounce (non-IFRS). Oxide tailings project: LOM plant feed 54.5 g/t Ag, 0.47 g/t Au; recoveries 77.2% Ag, 81.6% Au.

Development-stage silver-gold project, Durango state (near Avino Mine). On August 25, 2025, Avino acquired 100% ownership by purchasing and extinguishing all outstanding royalties/obligations to Deterra Royalties ($13.25M upfront + $8.75M deferred). M&I resources 17.441 Mt @ 202 g/t AgEq (176 g/t Ag, 0.34 g/t Au) = 113.14 Moz AgEq, 98.59 Moz Ag, 189.19 koz Au; inferred 4.397 Mt. No production in FY2025.

notes: FY2025 annual report (40-F, year ended December 31, 2025, filed March 27, 2026) used. Revenue $92.2M; net income $26.6M. P&P reserves are the Avino Oxide Tailings Project only: 6.70 Mt @ 55 g/t Ag, 0.47 g/t Au = 11.75 Moz Ag contained (eff. Jan 16, 2024; Au contained not stated). No production decisions based on NI 43-101-compliant reserves per company disclosure. Costs are non-IFRS per AgEq payable ounce sold; not comparable to per-oz gold AISC.
